title: Offline Policy Evaluation of Multi-Turn LLM Health Coaching with Real Users

bias_targets.methodology: Offline Policy Evaluation (OPE) using SNIPS and AIPW estimators on deployment logs to compare objective tool outcomes and user satisfaction across subgroups with high versus low health literacy.
Evaluating counterfactual decision policies via OPE to measure performance and satisfaction disparities across user archetypes defined by high versus low self-efficacy.
